stemMd: Light passes from air into glass at an oblique angle. Which quantity remains unchanged across the boundary?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Angle to the normal in every case

explanationMd: The oscillation frequency is set by the source and remains continuous across a stationary boundary. In glass the speed is lower, so wavelength decreases according to v = fλ. Direction generally changes according to refraction.

distractorRationale.d: Light speed changes with the refractive index of the medium.
distractorRationale.e: Wavelength changes when speed changes at fixed frequency.
distractorRationale.b: Both generally change at the interface.
